mission: 把血细胞生产与更新、外周血读数、免疫识别与效应、耐受与反应终止、克隆秩序以及感染局限/源控制压缩成一个可反向定位的系统：先判断异常发生在生产、成熟、外周破坏/丢失、止血、克隆控制、免疫耐受/防御，还是感染局限失败，再用形态、实验室、免疫/遗传、病理和病原证据定位第一故障与当前危险。

mental_model.mother_model: 骨髓持续生产并成熟各系血细胞 → 外周血把细胞与血浆成分送到全身并形成可观测读数 → 免疫系统区分自身、病原、异常克隆与同种异体 → 效应反应清除威胁并与止血/炎症协同 → 耐受与负反馈限制附带损伤 → 局部解剖与源控制决定感染能否被局限 → 克隆控制维持正常分化与增殖边界；任一环失效都会在 CBC/Ret/骨髓、形态、凝血、免疫/遗传、病理或病原证据中留下可逆向定位的信号。
spine: 骨髓工厂：干/祖细胞分化、成熟、释放与反馈调节
循环产品：RBC/WBC/Plt与血浆成分执行携氧、防御、止血和运输
诊断观察层：CBC、Ret、外周涂片、骨髓穿刺/活检及功能性实验
识别层：自身/非自身、病原、异常克隆与同种异体识别
效应层：吞噬、抗体、T细胞、炎症和止血等Source支持的效应语言
耐受与刹车：避免自身攻击、持续放大、出血/血栓失衡及慢性损伤
感染战场：病原、宿主免疫、局部坏死/脓腔/异物/梗阻与源控制
克隆秩序：正常分化与增殖受控，异常克隆不应占据骨髓、血液和淋巴组织
loops: 生产—更新：干/祖细胞 → 分化成熟 → 外周释放 → 执行功能 → 衰老/清除/丢失 → 反馈调节新生
威胁—应答：病原/异物/异常细胞 → 识别 → Source支持的效应反应 → 清除/控制 → 终止或记忆接口
损伤—限制：炎症与止血保护宿主 → 过强时造成组织损伤/微循环问题 → 耐受、负反馈与源控制限制反应 → 修复或慢性化

core_relations: a blood-count abnormality must first be localized across production/maturation/release versus peripheral loss/destruction/distribution before a disease label is selected
MCV describes red-cell size while Ret reports marrow response; the pair separates morphology from production response and prevents anemia from becoming one undifferentiated list
CBC quantity, cell morphology/function and marrow structure are different evidence layers and must not be treated as interchangeable
bleeding is localized by platelet/vascular versus coagulation-factor versus consumption-fibrinolysis patterns; normal hemostasis itself remains a Circulation recall input
clonal hematologic disease requires lineage/maturation plus morphology/cytochemistry/immunophenotype/genetic evidence rather than one count or one marker in isolation

immune pathology is localized by whether defense is insufficient, self-tolerance is lost, or alloimmune direction is wrong; the Source only supports a minimum shared immune language, not a complete immunology curriculum

rheumatologic diagnosis starts from syndrome and organ combination, then uses antibodies/complement/inflammation/pathology according to their evidence role rather than treating a positive antibody as the diagnosis
infection outcome depends jointly on pathogen, host defense and local anatomy; necrosis, abscess, foreign body or obstruction can make antimicrobial exposure insufficient without source control

within Current C, severe infection is tracked when infection becomes systemic/uncontrolled and perfusion or organ-function threat emerges; H26 historical Source terminology stays explicit and no modern sepsis definition or scoring system is silently substituted
organ-specific infections remain with their organ System owners; C contributes shared pathogen–tissue-response, dissemination, immune-host and source-control language
failure_modes: 骨髓或造血刺激不足，导致一个或多个血细胞系产量不足
细胞形成但成熟/功能异常，甚至在骨髓内死亡，外周有效产出不足
出血、溶血、免疫破坏或脾相关清除使外周细胞减少
细胞数量可不低但膜、酶、珠蛋白、白细胞杀菌或血小板功能异常
血小板/凝血/纤溶失衡导致出血、血栓或DIC样消耗
克隆性扩张或分化停滞
异常克隆占据造血/淋巴空间或阻断正常分化，形成MDS、白血病、淋巴瘤或浆细胞病等
免疫效应错误指向自身抗原/组织，造成多系统炎症与器官损伤
T/B细胞、粒细胞或整体免疫储备不足，使机会性感染/特定肿瘤风险增加
感染无法局限或源控制失败
病原毒力、宿主脆弱和局部坏死/脓腔/异物/梗阻使局部感染扩散并可进入脓毒症
供受者之间的抗原/免疫活性细胞方向错误导致输血不相容、移植排斥或GVHD等
judgment_axes: 生产不足 vs 无效成熟 vs 外周丢失/破坏 vs 分布异常
数量异常 vs 形态/功能异常
外周血证据 vs 骨髓细胞层证据 vs 骨髓结构层证据
贫血的MCV坐标 vs Ret反应坐标
血小板/血管性出血 vs 凝血因子性出血 vs DIC/纤溶消耗
非克隆性反应 vs 克隆性增殖；成熟细胞增多 vs 原始/分化停滞
形态 vs 细胞化学 vs 免疫表型 vs 遗传学证据角色
自身免疫过强/错向 vs 免疫缺陷不足
排斥反应：受者攻击移植物 vs GVHD：移植物免疫细胞攻击宿主
局部感染/可源控制 vs 播散/菌血症 vs 脓毒症/器官功能障碍
共同感染病理语言 vs 器官特异诊疗 owner
Source-supported immune/infection language vs 当前无Source支持的完整免疫/感染课程

block_families.label: 共同血液诊断与输血底座
block_families.role: 建立血细胞生命史、CBC/Ret/骨髓读数和同种输入方向语言

block_families.label: 贫血与止血异常
block_families.role: 从贫血坐标推进到骨髓衰竭、溶血与出血定位；正常止血只作Recall输入

block_families.label: 克隆性造血与血液肿瘤
block_families.role: 用统一克隆/分化/证据层解释MDS、MM、急性白血病、CML与淋巴瘤

block_families.label: 最低免疫与同种免疫语言
block_families.role: 建立Source支持的超敏/耐受、免疫缺陷/HIV和移植排斥/GVHD最低共同语言

block_families.label: 风湿免疫疾病
block_families.role: 先建立风湿证据/治疗角色，再进入SLE/APS、RA、Sjögren和血管炎/Behçet

block_families.label: 感染病理、源控制与系统失控
block_families.role: 保留共同感染病理、跨器官整合、局部源控制和脓毒症，不复制器官System完整感染诊疗

inputs: A1 Circulation: normal hemostasis, thrombosis/DIC consequences, perfusion/shock and infective-endocarditis interfaces
A2 Respiratory: Hb/SaO2/CaO2 oxygen-delivery boundary, pulmonary TB/opportunistic-infection interfaces and respiratory failure
A3 Urinary: EPO/renal anemia, CKD bleeding, myeloma kidney, autoimmune/vasculitic renal injury and AKI interfaces
B Digestive/Metabolic/Endocrine/Tumor: iron/B12/folate absorption, RBC metabolism, one-carbon/heme-bilirubin/nucleotide/tumor-molecular language, liver coagulation and abdominal infection interfaces
O9 Tumor General: tumor/clonal common language where canonical Blocks explicitly call that gate
outputs: D Neuro/Sensory/Motor/Orthopedics: CNS-infection pathology entry, B12 neurologic injury, vasculitic neuropathy, myeloma bone disease, RA joint destruction and infection interfaces
E Reproductive/Breast: ABO/Rh, APS/pregnancy-loss interface, HIV/STI and maternal-fetal alloimmune/transfusion interfaces

all Systems: CBC/Ret/marrow interpretation, anemia/bleeding/infection entry coordinates, autoimmunity/immunodeficiency coordinate, clonal evidence layers, infection severity/source-control/sepsis judgment
